Reasoning: The stage is encoded as a stacking/lowering goal for the currently gripped cube_1: cube_1 must reach the point at cube_2 plus world +z 0.05 m within 0.01 m. The reach condition includes both geometry and manipulator_high_effort so the controller can treat either geometric arrival or sustained contact/effort during lowering as the stopping condition, while still requiring the grasp to remain firm. The object_grasped term represents preserving the stable closed grasp of cube_1 rather than issuing a new close command. The freeze_orientation term preserves the panda_fingertip start-of-stage orientation within 5 degrees. Unrepresented details: exact per-finger joint start-value holding with only symmetric inward adjustment/no opening is not directly expressible; preserving the exact rigid transform from the tool frame to the cube center is only approximated by object_grasped plus fixed tool orientation; strict world -z path travel of exactly 0.11 m and continuous lateral alignment throughout the path cannot be added because the API permits at most one position operator, so the final stacking goal was prioritized. Monitoring signals and stop-on-grasp-loss/excessive-unintended-contact are runtime safety policies not directly expressible as Constraint terms.
